name: cancel_cod
description: Cancel request where payment method is COD - expected behavior: service marks COMPLETED and refundAmount becomes null/COMPLETED
reason: Customer canceled the order before it was shipped.

name: cancel_transfer
description: Cancel request where payment method is transfer (non-COD) - expected behavior: service sets COMPLETED and refundStatus=PENDING_PROCESSING; refundAmount provided
reason: Customer canceled after checkout; payed via bank transfer.

name: return_no_bank_info
description: Return request where customer hasn't provided bank info yet - expected behavior: refundStatus=PENDING_CUSTOMER_INFO
reason: Received damaged item - requesting return and refund.

name: return_with_bank_info
description: Return request where customer already supplied bank info - expected behavior: admin can process and refundStatus moves along processing/completed
reason: Wrong color/size delivered - returning and requesting refund.

name: return_with_media_only
description: Return request including media ids (images/proof) - used to test requestMedia linking
